title: Kra–Dai languages facts for kids
text: You might also hear them called Tai–Kadai or Daic languages. These languages are special because they are tonal. This means the meaning of a word can change based on the pitch of your voice. Think of it like singing a word differently to make it mean something else! Two well-known Kra–Dai languages are Thai and Lao.
